overview: This USHO Gas Solid Top oven range is the perfect addition to any commercial kitchen. The robust design of the stainless steel exterior and solid plate top ensures that it can withstand continuous use and pressure, making it ideal for busy restaurants and other food businesses.

The unique solid top allows intense, variable heat across the plate to facilitate simmering or boiling without having to adjust the thermostat. The top also comes with a removable bullseye, suitable for use with wok pans. Not only this, but its easy-clean design means that you don't have to spend hours scrubbing away burnt-on food debris - just a quick wipe down with a damp cloth will do!

The oven comes with an automatic flame failure device and provides easy start up with the piezo ignition. It is thermostatically controlled, so you can be sure your food cooks to perfection every time. The enamel lined interior makes it easy to keep clean, and with two racks included and three shelf positions it offers versatile cooking options.

For added convenience, this oven also comes complete with braked castors so you can easily move it at the end of a shift or deep clean days whenever necessary. With all these features combined into one small package you'll never regret investing in an USHO oven for your business.
